ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white base (approx. 70%) with high-contrast low-intensity black borders and internal mottling (approx. 30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous black pigmentation along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; dense black stippling and vertical streaking across the white central field; a unique closed-loop black circular ring located in the mid-upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the fluke's vertical center-line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude jagged serrations on the distal tips of both lobes; transitioning to moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude undulations toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The left lobe follows a straighter, semi-linear trajectory toward the tip; the right lobe exhibits a more pronounced, broad convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of three-dimensional, high-contrast barnacles (rosettes) localized on the terminal ends of both the left and right lobes; smaller white circular scars scattered on the right lobe white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, non-parallel linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white field, most prominent on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization on both distal tips; distinct circular 'O' mark pigmentation on the right lobe; extensive rake marks consistent with interspecific interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: The perfect circularity of the dark ring on the right lobe is a highly unique geometric feature not typical of standard mottling.
